notes: White-dwarf luminosity function bound on Yukawa couplings of leptophilic/baryophilic scalars via electron-nucleus bremsstrahlung. Main leptophilic result: g_L <~ 4e-16 (alpha_e <~ 1.2e-32), baryophilic g_B <~ 7e-13 (alpha_B <~ 3.4e-26), and Higgs-portal sin(theta) <~ 1.9e-10 for m_phi <~ 1 keV (fifth-force dominates below ~0.5 eV). The plotted result (Fig. 3) is in sin(theta) vs m_phi, spanning roughly 1e-3 to 1e3 eV. Coupling type is ambiguous: the scalar couples to electron mass (leptophilic, ScalarElectron-like via g_e = (m_e/v) sin theta) but also to nucleons (baryophilic/ScalarNucleon) and via Higgs portal to both. I emitted the sin(theta) Higgs-portal line as the primary plotted result; note this is NOT a standard d_me convention. Confidence lowered due to coupling-type ambiguity and non-standard convention.
